name: elasticsearch-nodejs-server
description: Elasticsearch-backed Node.js server with a React client to search and explore syslog data.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k --names "server,client" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.start: concurrently -k --names "server,client" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run start" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.reinstall: npm run clean && npm run install:all
